An Israeli-born, Trump-appointed acting U.S. attorney - who has referred to
Palestinians as **" animals,"** called for Gaza to be wiped **" off the
map,"** and suggested **" even the children"** in Gaza are terrorists -
dropped a gun charge against an Israeli immigrant who operated a biolab in
Nevada.

Her name is Sigal Chattah.

These developments come after Nevada authorities released an Israeli
cybersecurity official on bail following his arrest in a police operation
targeting alleged online child predators - allowing him to [flee to
Israel](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/aug/19/israeli-official-
soliciting-minor-las-vegas) before stricter conditions were imposed (Chattah
sought to
[distance](https://x.com/USAttyChattah/status/1957632795003785566?s=20)
herself from the fiasco, pinning it on local authorities).

You're reading this all right. Let's walk through this thicket together.

In Las Vegas in January, property manager Ori Solomon was
[arrested](https://www.ktnv.com/news/crime/property-manager-arrested-amid-
investigation-into-illegal-biological-lab-in-las-vegas) on a felony charge of
improperly disposing of hazardous waste, as part of an investigation into an
illegal biological lab found inside a home also available to rent on Airbnb.

Two people who entered the home's garage - which held refrigerators containing
vials of unidentified liquids -
[reportedly](https://abcnews.com/US/housecleaner-multiple-illnesses-tied-las-
vegas-house-bio/story?id=129865238) fell **" deathly ill"** and **" could not
get out of bed."**

Materials in the home Solomon managed were
"[consistent](https://abc30.com/post/officials-give-update-reedley-biolab-
amid-connection-las-vegas-lab/18534494/) in appearance" to items found in a
California lab [allegedly](https://www.ktnv.com/news/crime/property-manager-
arrested-amid-investigation-into-illegal-biological-lab-in-las-vegas) used to
manufacture unauthorized test kits, including for pregnancy and COVID-19.
Around 1,000 lab mice in poor condition were reportedly found in that lab,
along with vials labeled with names of diseases including HIV, malaria, and
Ebola. Chinese national Jia Bei Zhu - who has been criminally convicted for
fraudulently selling COVID tests - was
[linked](https://www.ktnv.com/news/crime/man-with-ties-to-las-vegas-biolab-
found-guilty-for-operating-separate-california-lab) to both properties.

Shortly after Solomon's arrest, he was also
[charged](https://www.ktnv.com/news/crime/property-manager-facing-additional-
gun-charge-as-part-of-investigation-into-illegal-biological-lab) with
possession of a firearm by a prohibited person, because his non-immigrant visa
prevented him from owning or possessing a gun.

And then, on May 11, the federal government
[dismissed](https://sjvsun.com/health/feds-drop-charges-against-las-vegas-
property-manager-linked-to-secret-reedley-lab/) the federal charges against
Solomon, without prejudice. In their motion to dismiss, prosecutors said that
**" after a careful review of the evidence and additional information provided
by defendant," **they** "concluded that the interests of justice require
dismissal of the complaint at this time." **No more information was given.
